summary: Framework-free REST method/path dispatch now calls implemented backbone write-route business handlers.
claim_boundary: This slice adds typed framework-free write-route dispatch in REST crates for already implemented write handlers. It maps OpenAPI method/path plus typed payload enums to the existing validated business handlers and refuses contract-only routes. It does not parse JSON, bind Hyper, deploy a production gateway, add TLS, implement still-contract-only endpoints, execute SQL, publish broker messages, or claim live service runtime evidence.

source_basis.use: Existing REST route catalog, typed post-message handler, and fail-closed contract-only dispatcher pattern.
Existing mail submit-message REST handler and route catalog.
Existing social publish-post REST handler and route catalog.
Existing community create-post, cast-vote, and moderation-action REST handlers and route catalog.

facets.F1_simplicity: Each REST crate gets small enum-based dispatch over existing handlers instead of introducing a web framework, JSON parser, macro router, or gateway runtime.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: The service boundary now has deterministic method/path-to-handler seams for implemented write routes, reducing later gateway composition risk while retaining independent service scaling boundaries.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests cover successful method/path dispatch for implemented routes and fail-closed refusal for contract-only routes; existing unknown-route and typed-handler-required tests remain intact.
facets.F4_api_contract: OpenAPI route tables are unchanged; implemented routes gain dispatcher entrypoints while contract-only routes remain explicit 501/non-claim paths.
facets.F5_quality: Focused REST tests/clippy/fmt plus the 47-package backbone check/test/clippy/fmt matrix, cargo-deny, license-policy, cargo-prefix, catalog/data-class known-blocker probes, parse validation, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F6_operations: Runtime gateway composition can call a single framework-free dispatch function per REST crate for implemented write routes; still-contract-only endpoints remain safely refused.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Dispatch calls the existing handlers, preserving API context validation, policy-decision requirements, principal binding, and no body/secret logging.
facets.F8_supply_chain: No new third-party dependencies are introduced by this slice.
facets.F9_testing: Focused REST packages passed 50 unit tests; the broad backbone matrix passed 312 unit tests across 47 packages plus one existing ignored metrics adapter doctest.
facets.F10_ci_cd: The touched REST crates are already present in the backbone GitHub Actions and Jenkins matrices; no remote CI run is claimed.
facets.F11_observability: The dispatch path preserves existing telemetry binding functions for implemented route operation IDs; it does not emit metrics by itself.
facets.F13_reversibility: The change is isolated to four REST crates and task/evidence metadata; reverting removes dispatcher enums/functions without changing API/usecase/app layers.
